narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A straight angle is three hundred and sixty degrees, because it is a whole straight line.
<bookmark mark='half'/>Watch the hand go from the top to the bottom. It covers only half of the circle.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Three hundred and sixty degrees is the whole turn back to the start, not a straight angle.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A full turn is three hundred and sixty degrees, and half a turn is half of that.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Farhan turns a wheel three quarters of a full turn. How many degrees has it turned?
